listing.title: Complete Set - National Geographic Magazine 1960-1969 - 120 Issues
listing.description: A complete decade of National Geographic, every issue from January 1960 through December 1969, one hundred and twenty issues in total. Stored flat in a dry loft for forty years. Condition varies by issue and I have graded each one individually below. The 1960 and 1961 runs are the strongest, with bright spines and no sun fading. The 1962 run has three issues with light water staining to the lower corner, affecting the rear advertising pages only and not the editorial content. The 1963 to 1965 issues are uniformly good with minor shelf wear to the spine ends. Several issues from 1966 retain their original fold-out maps, which are frequently missing from sets of this age, and I have checked each one. The 1967 run includes the well-known feature on the Six Day War. The 1968 issues are complete but two have a previous owner's name written in ink on the front cover in the upper right corner. The 1969 run includes the July issue covering the Apollo 11 landing, which is the single most collected issue of the decade, and this copy is in excellent condition with the supplementary moon map still attached and unfolded. Shipping will be in two boxes due to weight. I am happy to provide additional photographs of any individual issue on request. No returns on the set as a whole but I will describe any issue in more detail before purchase.
